# Scotland ITS Network Performance

An end-to-end analytics platform over 100,000 hourly observations from 74 sensor
sites on the Scottish strategic road network, April 2023 to September 2025.
Raw sensor feed to board-level economics, with the data quality layer left visible.

```sql headline
select
    sum(annualised_cost_gbp) / 1e6                                     as annual_cost_m,
    sum(annualised_carbon_cost_gbp) / sum(annualised_cost_gbp)         as carbon_share,
    sum(mean_journey_time_index * observation_count)
        / sum(observation_count)                                       as jti,
    sum(observation_count)                                             as observations,
    sum(collisions)                                                    as collisions
from rpt_d1_executive
```

<BigValue data={headline} value=annual_cost_m fmt='num1' title="Annual economic cost (£m)"/>
<BigValue data={headline} value=jti fmt='num3' title="Journey Time Index"/>
<BigValue data={headline} value=carbon_share fmt='pct1' title="of cost is carbon"/>
<BigValue data={headline} value=observations fmt='num0' title="Clean observations"/>
<BigValue data={headline} value=collisions fmt='num0' title="Collisions observed"/>

## What the network costs

```sql cost_components
select 'Carbon' as component, sum(annualised_carbon_cost_gbp)/1e6 as cost_m from rpt_d1_executive
union all
select 'Delay', sum(annualised_delay_cost_gbp)/1e6 from rpt_d1_executive
union all
select 'Collisions', sum(annualised_collision_cost_gbp)/1e6 from rpt_d1_executive
union all
select 'Breakdown', sum(annualised_breakdown_cost_gbp)/1e6 from rpt_d1_executive
order by cost_m desc
```

<BarChart
    data={cost_components}
    x=component
    y=cost_m
    yAxisTitle="£m per year"
    title="Annualised economic cost by component"
    swapXY=true
/>

The headline finding is that **carbon is the largest single component**, ahead of
journey time delay. Networks like this are usually managed as congestion problems.
Valued at the DESNZ central non-traded price of £273 per tonne, this one is
a carbon problem that happens to express itself as congestion.

## Where the cost sits

```sql concentration
with ranked as (
    select site_code, city_name, road_name, corridor,
           annualised_cost_gbp / 1e6 as cost_m,
           row_number() over (order by annualised_cost_gbp desc) as rn
    from agg_site_risk_ranking
)
select site_code, city_name, road_name, corridor, cost_m
from ranked
where rn <= 10
order by cost_m desc
```

<DataTable data={concentration} rows=10>
    <Column id=site_code title="Site"/>
    <Column id=road_name title="Road"/>
    <Column id=city_name title="City"/>
    <Column id=cost_m title="£m / year" fmt='num1' contentType=colorscale/>
</DataTable>

**34% of the network's annual cost sits in 10 of 74 sites.** Intervention can be
targeted rather than universal — which is the difference between a fundable
business case and an unfundable one.
